column12: — He stands at the far end of oblivion —
Original Story|---|20:Kazushi Hagiwara|10:Published in Jump Comics
The precious memories he has lost —
In a moment both instant and eternal —

With Satan, the Demon King, now slain, D.S.|has become the mightiest being in the universe.|Not even the schemes of the Hollow Gods can|shake his boundless power. With the freed|Yoko at its center, his long-dreamed-of harem|forms a new mandala across the cosmos!|Wahahahaha!
